coverage.actual_sdpa_arguments: Q/K/V/mask descriptors and flags; no selected CUDA kernel or mask-content hash claim.
coverage.metadata_correction: Producer uncropped_token_count mislabeled len(BatchEncoding); retained-field value preserved and explicit input_ids token length reported independently.
coverage.producer_plan_job_id: Optional by frozen producer schema; wrapper/source/summary job identities joined explicitly.
coverage.recursive_per_case_error_scope: Every response leaf also retains both per-case full-field errors; these repeat primary case errors and carried coordinates, not new independent observations or physical transitions.
coverage.response_context_leaves: Every recursive saved tensor leaf, including carried inputs and all context leaves; coordinate counts overlap across clocks.

interpretation: Two complete own-state image paths under different source mask/GQA regimes, one replay control and one prospective long case. Shared primitives, single seed, combined content/truncation/dispatch contrast. Common-prefix numerical drift is diagnostic, not target prediction error. Original forecasts/producer unchanged through all saved-reader repairs.

long.scope: Retained tokenizer/template reapplied offline, no original asset lookup or neural calls. Content and truncated suffix also change; not an isolated padding intervention.
long.uncropped_count_correction: Frozen producer used len(default BatchEncoding), counting mapping fields. Actual token count independently extracted from explicit input_ids; original field preserved, no numerical failure inferred.
